summaryZh: Rose 实验室开展前列腺癌人群研究，分析治疗安全性、药物影响及相关结局。团队使用 VINCI 和 Million Veteran Project 等大型数据库。
researchQuestions: 遗传因素如何影响前列腺癌风险，以及不同族群的癌症筛查和治疗？

evidence.quote: Dr. Brent Rose The major focus of Dr. Rose’s lab is on population sciences research, in particular analyses of large databases of prostate cancer patients. Recent work includes assessment of the impact of pre-diagnostic 5α-reductase inhibitor, the association between dementia and androgen deprivation therapy in prostate cancer patients undergoing definitive RT and the safety of active surveillance in African-American men with low-risk prostate cancer. His group focuses on multiple large databases including VINCI and the Million Veteran Project within the Veterans Administration system. Support Dr. Rose’s research is supported by 4-year $806K Department of Defense grant. Explore the Lab People Learn more about the dedicated team in Dr. Brent Rose's lab. Meet Our Team Publications Explore the latest publications from Dr. Brent Rose's lab. See Publications Featured Articles Adverse Impact of Pre-Diagnostic 5α-Reductase Inhibitors No Association Between ADT and Dementia in Prostate Cancer Patients Undergoing RT 3-Month Post-Treatment PSA Level as a Prognostic Biomarker

Currently, he is investigating how inherited genetic factors influence prostate cancer risk, as well as their impact on cancer screening and treatment across all racial groups. His research group leverages large databases including VINCI and the Million Veterans Project.
